name: Tacos
intro: Roasted sweet potato and poblano make the October taco. Pomegranate does what salsa would.
season_options: Salted Greek yogurt, instead of crema
Cilantro, if you still have it

variations.context: The October taco. No meat, no compromise.
If you saw it. Flour tortillas for this one.

works_well_with: Spiny lobster, in season from October
finish: Warm the tortillas over a flame or in a dry pan until they blister in spots, and stack them under a towel. Pomegranate goes on last, so it stays cold against the warm filling.
